openwith.title: Open with
openwith.none: Nothing here can open this kind of file. Download it instead.
openwith.always: Always use this app for {ext} files
openwith.hint.photo: Zoom, spin, slideshow and camera deets
openwith.hint.video: Subs, speed, picture-in-picture, picks up where you left off
openwith.hint.music: Queue, shuffle, repeat; keeps the vibes going in the background
openwith.hint.text: Edit it and save as plain text
openwith.hint.quicklook: Shows the file in a simple window
openwith.hint.browser: Pops it open in a new tab of this browser
openwith.hint.archive: Unpacks it right into this folder
